subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `after_compaction` hooks receive a public `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` capability that automatically replaces the current routed session after compaction?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive plugin API and changes the documented operator-controlled recovery model; code correctness alone cannot establish whether that permanent product contract is desired.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, fix all lifecycle ownership blockers, document the contract, and require full latest-head behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not publish the hook API; instead implement the required recovery as an owner-controlled core or plugin-specific lifecycle action.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only deferred design, fix all lifecycle ownership blockers, document the contract, and require full latest-head behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Codex compaction-ownership work is the closest available history signal for deciding how native compaction events should interact with OpenClaw session replacement.
